standard_prerequisites: Regular local rings of characteristic p, the Frobenius Twist [kappa : kappa^p], and excellence
Formal etaleness = formal unramifiedness plus formal smoothness; Omega_{A^/A} = 0 detects formal unramifiedness

The Neron-Popescu desingularization (Smoothing Ring Maps, theorem-popescu): the completion of an excellent G-ring is a filtered colimit of smooth A-algebras; NL and the vanishing criterion for formal smoothness (Algebra, proposition-characterize-formally-smooth)
core_obligations: Backward: if A -> A^ is formally etale it is in particular formally smooth, and excellence follows by the completion-etale lemma (its converse half)
Forward: by the completion-etale lemma A -> A^ is formally unramified, i.e. Omega_{A^/A} = 0; it remains to prove formal smoothness when A is excellent
Neron-Popescu writes A -> A^ as a filtered colimit of smooth A-algebras, so NL_{A^/A} has vanishing cohomology in degree -1, and formal smoothness follows from the Algebra characterization
proof_roadmap: Backward direction from the formally-etale hypothesis via the completion-etale lemma
Reduce the forward direction to formal smoothness, using Omega = 0 from the same lemma
Apply Neron-Popescu desingularization and the NL vanishing criterion to conclude formal smoothness
